blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Moody total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Port Moody Centre fell from 144 in June to 120 in September (−16.7%), and 92 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 62.5% of Port Moody’s 192 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Port Moody Centre?
Port Moody Centre also had 15 houses listed and 2 sold in September, against 120 condos and townhomes listed. The Port Moody Centre houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Port Moody Centre?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 120 condos and townhomes listed in Port Moody Centre. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Port Moody Centre a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Port Moody Centre had a sales ratio of 13%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Port Moody Centre from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 92 condos and townhomes sold in Port Moody Centre over those 4 months, out of 141 in all of Port Moody.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
